facts.fact: The Naval Museum is on Mariano Arista418 in the historic centre.
Its displays include model ships, navigation instruments and uniforms.
facts.excerpt: barcos a escala, instrumentos de navegación, uniformes

facts.fact: The museum has an area aimed at young visitors and a navigation simulator.
facts.excerpt: Discovery Room (área especializada para los pequeños visitantes del museo) y un simulador de navegación

facts.fact: The displays explain the Mexican Navy’s history and activities.
facts.excerpt: comprender y entender la existencia y el quehacer de la Armada de México
